ciphersplat.name: CipherSplat
ciphersplat.description: Encrypt and unlock files, folders, and text on this device.
help: Use password encryption for .csplat packages or OpenPGP for public-key encryption. Keep a recoverable original until you have tested decryption.
Folder restoration creates a new folder. Passwords and private keys are not stored. Website links open in your browser.

gifsplat.name: GIFsplat
gifsplat.description: Turn local images into animated GIFs, reorder frames, adjust timing, and save locally.
help: Import frames, arrange them and choose timing and quality. Save a .gifsplat project to retain editable frames and settings, then generate/export the animation.
Each imported image supplies one frame. Video export is available when the system webview supports recording. Ctrl/Cmd+S saves a project; Ctrl/Cmd+O opens one.

qrsplat.name: QRSplat
qrsplat.description: Generate standard QR codes for text, websites, email, phone, and Wi-Fi without a network service.
help: Export PNG or SVG and scan the result on a real device before printing. Save a .qrsplat project for portable styling, content and logos. QR codes expose their content to anyone who scans them.
Project files and explicitly saved presets exclude Wi-Fi passwords. Configured editable QR services require optional online connections in Settings. Service keys are not stored.

imagesplat.name: ImageSplat
imagesplat.description: Edit images with layers, text, shapes, crop, photo adjustments, blur, and local PNG/GIF exports.
help: Save an .imagesplat project to preserve layers, text and canvas settings. PNG/GIF exports produce shareable artwork. Ctrl/Cmd+S saves a project; Ctrl/Cmd+O opens one.

Fast photo background removal, white/color removal and embedded FontSplat lettering are bundled for offline use. Best-model downloads and online backgrounds require optional connections in Settings. Live capture depends on webview and device support.

audiosplat.name: AudioSplat
audiosplat.description: Record, arrange and edit multitrack audio with effects and local WAV/MP3 exports.
help: Import local audio or record with a supported microphone. Edit clips, tracks and effects; export WAV/MP3 or save a portable .audiosplat.json project with embedded audio.

Workspaces and transcripts stay in memory. Save a project before closing. Speech models require optional connections or a local GGML .bin file. Recording and optional codecs depend on the system webview and device permissions.

videosplat.name: VideoSplat
videosplat.description: Edit local video with layered timelines, titles, captions, audio mixing and local exports.
help: Import local video, audio and images, arrange a timeline, and export locally. Save a portable .videosplat.json project with embedded source media (up to 256 MB total). Browser project manifests can be opened and missing media relinked.

Workspaces and transcripts stay in memory. Save before closing. The FFmpeg conversion engine is bundled. Recording, WebM composition and hardware codecs depend on the system webview. Speech models require optional connections or a local GGML .bin file.
